'''Kruc''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Kitonak/Legends|Kitonak]] who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] in around [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="20 BBY">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' states that the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|''Living Force'']] campaign is set one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], an event that is dated to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. As the ''Living Force'' adventure ''[[Below the Belt: Philology|Philology]]'' [[Cularin's disappearance|moved]] the campaign forward ten years to the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], and the adventure ''[[Night Eyes: Night's Homecoming|Night's Homecoming]]'' established that by Year 4 of the campaign over a year had elapsed since the events of ''Philology'', ''[[Jigsaw: In the Name of the Maker|In the Name of the Maker]]'' can therefore be dated to circa [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].</ref> Kruc owned a [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] and, was present with it outside a restaurant in [[Gadrin]], when he was passed by a speeder containing the [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Imik Suum]] and another speeder that was pursuing Suum.

==Behind the scenes==
In ''[[Jigsaw: In the Name of the Maker|In the Name of the Maker]]'', it is possible for the player characters to persuade Kruc to help them chase after Suum's pursuers.
